title: Figure 2: Tory-IIC Ready for Testing (LLNL); Figure 3: PTRE Turbojet/Ramjet Modes
description: Color photograph of the Tory-IIC nuclear ramjet engine mounted on a rail test car in a desert setting with mountains behind, captioned "Figure 2. Tory-IIC Ready for Testing (courtesy LLNL)." Below is a cutaway schematic of a positron turbojet/ramjet engine with labels "positron trap," "turbojet turbine," "tungsten shells used for heating," "turbojet compressor," "turbojet heating chamber" and "nozzle." It is captioned "Figure 3. PTRE Turbojet (green) and Turbo-Ramjet (red) Modes (courtesy Positronics Research LLC)."
